failure.message: probabilities rows must sum to one
failure.cause: The exact checksum-loaded FLARE-24 reference was persisted as three float32 columns. Their float64 row sums differed from one by at most 4.44706529378891e-08, while joint_binary_marginals applies a 1e-08 zero-relative-tolerance contract.

adjudication: Preserve v4.
